g.title: crate Arvane assets: images, SVG and font files.
crate::detached Track worker detach facts below execution and shutdown orchestration.
crate::error Asset failures and their messages.
crate::fit Where an image goes in its box: CSS `object-fit`.
crate::font Font files and family names.
crate::format Image format detection from the content, never from the file extension.
crate::limits Defines asset loading and rasterization limits.
crate::pixels Pixel buffers, device sizes for SVG rasters and the monochrome tint.
crate::raster Raster decoding of PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP to straight-alpha RGBA8.
crate::read Reading an asset's encoded bytes from memory or from files on disk.
crate::source Asset path URL detection for loader policy.
crate::store The asset store: one per host instance.
crate::store::asset_store AssetStore: schedules asset jobs and answers images and pixels from its cache.
crate::store::entry Cache entry of the asset store: its state, derived variants and stamps.
crate::store::evict Eviction that keeps the asset cache within its budget.
crate::store::image_state Defines the observable state of a loaded image.
crate::store::job The store's jobs: loading and decoding assets and rasterizing SVGs.
crate::store::worker The store's worker thread, which runs jobs in order and wakes the host.
crate::svg SVG parsing and rasterization at an exact device size.
crate::svg::document A parsed SVG: parsing, memory estimate and exact-size rasterization.
crate::svg::nesting Cheap pre-scan of SVG text for deep nesting and entity expansion.
crate::svg::svgz SVGZ decompression through a reader bounded by the encoded size limit.
